freeze_rule: Per scene: rng = random.Random(N1D_SEED), iterated over that scene's N1 anchors in frozen order (checkpoint asc, anchor_id asc); partners = rng.sample(pool partner ids in frozen pool order, 3) — without replacement, outcome- and gradient-blind, frozen BEFORE any N1D action. A2-rk uses partners[k-1].

reused_from_n1.anchors: exact N1 anchors (64 per checkpoint per scene)
